**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Sir](../persons.html#1144),
I did not mean to publish the two volumes of the [History of Christian Names](../books.html#48) separately.[^1] The second is in a state of forwardness, but I thought I had explained when I saw you that I thought it would save time to have the 1st in the press while I am going over the 2nd again.
I imagine 2000 copies will be sufficient for a first edition.

My direction till the 20th will be the [Revd W Butler](../persons.html#244)’s
						 Vicarage
							Wantage	
Yours faithfully
C.M.

Yonge

[^1]: It was published in two volumes by Parker, Son and Bourn in 1863.

This letter may perhaps have been addressed to [William Butler Bourn](../persons.html#178) rather than the elder Parker.
